basic_info.description: Welcome to 135 Dorado Terrace, a modern top-floor condo w/lovely hillside views in a quiet neighborhood of its own within Mt Davidson Manor. This expansive condo has been in the same family since it was built & has been extensively remodeled & updated. This move-in-ready home features 3 spacious bedrms, 2 full baths & an open living/dining room w/gas fireplace & delightful hillside outlooks. The living & dining rooms have direct access to the large, remodeled, eat-in kitchen offering both function & style w/sleek quartz countertops, SS appliances & views! The well-scaled primary suite is outfitted w/2 generous closets & chic full bath w/glass shower & bench seating. The 2 add'l bedrms are spacious in size & served by a large hall bath. The home has been lovingly upgraded w/newer luxury vinyl plank flooring, newer roof(2024),freshly painted interior, newer Toto toilets, newer kitchen appliances & countertops. This special home includes private laundry, storage, 1 garage pkg & deeded roof top w/interior access & ocean views (possible roof deck?). Close proximity to Ocean Ave & West Portal shopping w/popular cafes, shops & services & near a variety of schools, parks, Muni K Line & 280 & 101. This stunning home offers the perfect blend of location, size, modern floor plan & views!
